course_name_original: Métallurgie de la mise en forme

learning_outcomes.text: analyze the microstructural transformations taking place, at different scales, during hot metal working
identify and use specific tools for representing crystallographic textures
identify the implications of residual stresses on the properties of mechanical parts

syllabus_topics: Rheology of metal alloys, phenomena involved and main models
Metallurgical aspects of wrought and cold working
Measurement, analysis and control of crystallographic textures
Damage in forming processes, analysis tools and diagnostics
Residual stresses: estimation methods and effects on use properties
Demonstration of microstructural characterization tools: X-ray diffraction and EBSD
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (2*DS1+1*TP1)/3. DS1 and TP1 likely refer to specific continuous assessment and practical work components.
bibliography: Cornet et Hlawka ; Métallurgie mécanique ; éd. Ellipses ; 2010 ; ISBN 978-2-7298-6120-9
Col, L'emboutissage des aciers, l'Usine Nouvelle, Dunod, 2010
Metals Handbook volume 14 : Forming and Forging, ASM International, ninth edition, 1987, ISBN: 0-87170-020-4
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
